Terminal methyl-transfer step shared by ALL methylotrophic routes, so it detects methylotrophy without naming the substrate. Added because 7 mcrA+ MAGs in the PRJNA602310 catalogue (Methanofastidiosia, Thermoplasmatales) got no route at all: they are obligate methylotrophs that genuinely lack the H4MPT C1 pathway, and their substrate-specific methyltransferases have no licence-clean model (mtsA and mtmB both unresolvable in this NCBIfam release). WARNING: NF004889 is a subfamily-level model and is NOT specific on its own -- it hits 30 bacteria in that catalogue (Clostridiaceae, Fibrobacter, Syntrophomonadaceae). It is only safe because the methylotrophic gate also requires mcrA, which bacteria lack. Never use this marker outside that gate, and never drop the mcrA term. Within mcrA+ genomes it discriminated perfectly: 16/16 hits were methylotrophs (9 already called + the 7 gap), and no hydrogenotroph-only or acetoclastic-only methanogen was hit.
